com.alsoknownasfoo.spinrender.note: It renders the board with a 3D renderer on the computer (OpenGL), which a browser tab does not have.

com.github.Huaqiu-Electronics.kicad-hqpc.note: It runs. What it sends to a web service goes through this server once you grant it network access; the test machine has no network, so that part is untested.

com.github.Huaqiu-Electronics.kicad-hqse.note: It opens and prepares its work. What it sends to a web service goes through this server once you grant it network access; the test machine has no network, so that part is untested.

com.github.Steffen-W.KiCad-Parasitics.note: It runs the ngspice circuit simulator as a separate program.

com.github.adamws.kicad-git.note: Its button opens the Save Version dialog. The project's version history stands in for git here: a commit is a saved version.

com.github.aivon-pcba.aivon-plug-in-for-.note: It runs. What it sends to a web service goes through this server once you grant it network access; the test machine has no network, so that part is untested.

com.github.bbenchoff.orthoroute.note: It runs. What it sends to a web service goes through this server once you grant it network access; the test machine has no network, so that part is untested.

com.github.danielboston38.prefab-gate.note: Its check runs on the web editor's Design Rules Checker, which covers fewer rules than KiCad's desktop DRC. Zones are refilled first by the web editor's own filler. Read a pass as a first check, not as KiCad's verdict.

com.github.drewsum.kipi.note: Its Qt window and its numpy, scipy and matplotlib parts load. Its solver meshes the copper with the Triangle library, which is compiled code that has no build for the browser.

com.github.f-blaze.velatrace.note: Its window opens and its own router routes the board and draws the preview. Its approval step checks the route with the web editor's Design Rules Checker, which covers fewer rules than KiCad's desktop DRC, and its optional Freerouting engine needs Java on a computer.

com.github.fablabkerala.gerber2png-plugi.note: It makes the Gerber archive and hands it over as a download. Passing it straight to the Gerber2Png page needs a local network port: open that page and load the archive there.

com.github.kerstensrobin.kicad-breadboar.note: Its breadboard window opens, draws and takes parts. Simulating the circuit needs the ngspice program, which a browser does not have.

com.github.pcbway.PCBWay-Plug-in-for-Kic.note: It runs. What it sends to a web service goes through this server once you grant it network access; the test machine has no network, so that part is untested.

com.github.samuelcicuitstudio.traceforge.note: It starts a second program that talks to KiCad over a local network port; neither exists in a browser.

com.github.spice-projects.kicad-xyce-plu.note: It adds no board editor command.

com.github.usetraces.traces.note: It needs the traces server running on the same computer.

com.github.yaqwsx.kikit.note: It is only a pointer to KiKit, a command line program that is installed separately on a computer.

com.github.z2labs.z2ems.note: Its windows open and the setup is saved. Simulating needs the Z2 EMS engine, a desktop program.

com.infernoembedded.vulcans-trials.note: It runs a program that is bundled for the desktop.
